findings.observed: The production binary invokes startup.receive(); receiving learning establishes checkpoint access only and still requires real stage owners and pinned evidence trust.
Git search finds capture_original only at its definition and a freeze-owner test. It requires the original source readback and committed Cell owner, not a caller-created input/target.
Full execution returns from Circuit before literal Notes; finite Notes rejects circuit_task_enabled. Existing Notes execution is not by itself the Q24 sealed task source.

Source configuration restricts Compute/Decide to entry, permits only entry-origin edges with no feedback, and rejects Subcircuit/Join. Dataset projection requires exact source publication support, independent Terminal outcome, unit profile and HQ24I001 input. These checks must not be relaxed to rename a Notes receipt as eligible evidence.

append_observed_outcome_v2 verifies active run/episode Decision and appends independently authenticated Outcome. Notes readback returns retained operation/receipt and document facts; it does not supply the independent signed Outcome or utility contract. Exact-symbol search is scoped evidence, not a whole-program type proof.
TaskLedgersBeforeFinalHoldout explicitly excludes subsequent holdout estimator, signature verification and publication overhead. Existing totals alone do not establish full amortized net benefit.
No independent real B/C custody, new future-task observations or qualified net-benefit update was produced in this work.

required_original_inputs: Real document/screenshot task sources, Notes target, original session handoff and durable writer/recovery custody.
A deployed Observer independent from Generator, with its original principal/controller, signing capability and valid trust distribution.
Pre-registered utility, complete cost accounting, amortization window, terminality rules and unit profile.
The actual task Cell, sealed publication, candidate set and signed Decision with original support linkage.
Original dataset freeze and stage owner/witness capabilities, plus a normal non-root Root CURRENT path for the complete restart chain.

next_implementation_boundary.action: Recoverably deliver original Notes facts to the deployed independent Observer, then use the existing signed Outcome append path.
next_implementation_boundary.facts: Original operation, request digest, target, terminal receipt, fresh document revision/hash and separate readback availability.
next_implementation_boundary.unavailable_rule: Do not mint reward, substitute signer/trust, rename source support or repeat the Notes effect when an Outcome append is uncertain.
next_implementation_boundary.recovery_rule: Drive handoff from retained durable receipts and its own delivery recovery state; do not hide Ledger effects in status queries or depend solely on a post-terminal callback.
next_implementation_boundary.current_q24_limit: A versioned projection and actual source/Decision composition are still required if the task's evidence shape differs from HQ24I001.
